title: Contract Clause Review
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Judge eight clauses from a fictional AI product contract as acceptable, needing change, or a red flag.

learningObjectives: The learner will judge eight contract clauses from an AI product contract as acceptable, needing change, or a red flag, correctly judging at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Contract due diligence, vendor lock-in, data ownership, breach notice, deletion, and the contract checklist, from the section "Buying Responsibly" in Chapter 21 and from Chapter 10.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify one item at a time with immediate feedback; first-attempt scoring
keyQuestions: Is there a deadline, a cap, and an exit?
Does the clause allow any use beyond the service?
commonMisconceptions: A vague promise is as good as a stated deadline.
Any clause that favors the vendor is a red flag.
Student data may be used to train a vendor's models if the vendor says it is anonymous.
assessmentOpportunities: "Vendor will notify the district of a breach in a timely manner." What is the verdict?
Is every clause that favors the vendor a red flag?
A vendor says the student data it trains on is anonymous. Is that enough?

controls.name: Category buttons
controls.description: Choose the verdict for the current clause.

controls.name: Submit
controls.description: Checks the choice. Two tries per clause; only the first counts.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: Moves to the next clause. Finish shows the score.

controls.name: Start over
controls.description: Reshuffles and begins a new run.
